events.verdict: Murray (POR) directly contests Robinson's (DET) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Robinson's hand after the release.
Williams (POR) firms up to his right leg in Cunningham's (DET) path and absorbs the contact.
Grant (POR) does not extend his forearm when he releases from Harris (DET) as he steps back during his dribble on the perimeter.
Murray (POR) initiates contact with Robinson (DET), impeding him from his desired position off-ball.
Avdija's (POR) left hand makes direct contact with the ball to cleanly dislodge it from Holland (DET) during the driving shot attempt.
Williams  (POR) steps out of bounds while having possession of the ball. Play resumes with the possession correctly awarded to Detroit.
Duren (DET) does not maintain a legal guarding position as he moves into Grant's (POR) path, creating contact, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Sharpe (POR) extends his right hand and initiates contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm, and the contact affects his SQBR/ability to control the ball.
Stewart (DET) legally contests Grant's (POR) jump shot attempt and does not move into his space. Grant brings his right knee toward Stewart after the release and returns to the floor.
Avdija (POR) commits a take foul on Cunningham (DET).
